finalText:
**Repeats within 5 minutes of the last delivery now drop.** `99` events drop, 0 errors.

State holds `lastSentByKey`, a `Map` of key to last delivered minute. Only real deliveries update it, so a dropped repeat does not extend the window.

I read "in the last 5 minutes" as strictly under 5. An event exactly 5 minutes later still sends.

```
low       email=111  queue=90
normal    push=112  queue=88
high      sms=112  email=112  queue=88
critical  pager=200
```
